recent.message:
Restore equal-opportunity calibration in build_variant_d

build_variant_d in demo-model/train.py hard-coded group_thresholds={0: 0.5, 1: 0.5}
(a single global threshold), unlike build_variant_a and build_variant_b, which
derive per-group thresholds with _equal_opportunity_thresholds. The Witness
measured fairness_gap 0.1421 against a limit of 0.05 (FAIRNESS_GAP_EXCEEDED).

Compute the base model's training-set probabilities and derive per-group
thresholds with _equal_opportunity_thresholds from data/train.csv labels and
groups, as variants A and B do. No evaluation data is read. No threshold,
policy or Witness change.

Refs investigation issue #3, pipeline 2940522134.
recent.title: Restore equal-opportunity calibration in build_variant_d
